part.text:
All 20 tests pass, including `format-test`. The fix is in `include/fmt/core.h`: `specs_setter::on_zero` now only applies the `'0'` flag (setting `align::numeric` and zero fill) when no alignment was specified — per the standard, `'0'` is otherwise ignored. The now-unused `applied_numeric_align_`/`applied_zero_fill_` members were removed.

Verified behavior:
- `"{:<06}"` with -42 → `-42   `
- `"{:>06}"` with -42 → `   -42`
- `"{:06}"` with -42 → `-00042` (still works)
- explicit fill with align (`"{:*^06}"`) unaffected
